name: Shift Perspective
intro: Welcome. Today we're going to look at something familiar from an unfamiliar angle.
Our minds are pattern machines. They build stories quickly and believe them deeply.
But patterns can be rewritten. Perspectives can shift.
Take a slow breath. Let go of the need to be right.
body: Bring to mind a situation that's been difficult.
One that your mind keeps replaying. One that feels stuck.
Notice the story you've built around it. The meaning you've assigned.
Now, just for a moment, imagine removing all interpretation. Just the raw facts.
What happened, stripped of the story? What's actually left?
Your mind probably added a why. A reason. A motive.
What if that why is only one possibility among many?
What if the other person was afraid, not cruel? Careless, not intentional?
This isn't about excusing anything. It's about freeing yourself from a single narrative.
Multiple truths can exist at once.
Now think about what you've been telling yourself about your role in this.
Are you the villain in your own story? The helpless one? The one who always fails?
What if you're none of those? What if you're just someone doing their best with what they had?
Rewrite the character description. Be kinder to yourself.
You are not your worst interpretation of yourself.
Consider the idea that this difficult thing might be a chapter, not the whole book.
What if future you looks back on this and sees it as a turning point?
Not because it was good. But because of what you built from it.
You can't see the full picture from inside the frame.
Trust that the story isn't finished.
Let's build a new sentence about this situation.
Start with: This is hard, and...
Not but. And. Both things can be true.
This is hard, and I am learning. This is painful, and I am growing.
Hold both. That's not denial. That's wisdom.
closing: You don't have to adopt a new belief today.
Just knowing there are other angles is enough.
The mind that can question its own stories is a free mind.
Take a deep breath. You've loosened something today.
Open your eyes. The world looks a little different from here.
